create_benchmark_reducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer implementing join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_json_df_reducer: instantiate JsonDFReducer with a benchmark name and target data path to reduce JSON result files into a pandas DataFrame
compute_mae_metrics: call compute_metrics on a JsonDFReducer to calculate mean absolute error for common columns between results and target DataFrames
join_json_results: use JsonDFReducer join_results to concatenate multiple JSON result files from a directory into a single sorted DataFrame
save_and_log_metrics: call save_metrics to write a metrics DataFrame to a compressed JSON file and log_metrics to log it via WandBSingletonLogger
